description: This Java class 'EventNativeCodeProducer' implements code generation for native event handling, including header and source files for events and event adapters, using templates and processing event definitions within a larger code generation framework.

classes.name: EventNativeCodeProducer
classes.description: A class responsible for generating native C header and source files for events and event adapters based on templates and event definitions.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to generate event-related code files, including headers, source files, and adapters.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile
methods.description: Indicates that wrapper file generation is not applicable for native events.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Returns null as wrapper buffer generation is not applicable for native events.

methods.name: generateNativeEventHeader
methods.description: Generates the C header file containing event codes, enums, and typedefs.

methods.name: generateNativeEventSource
methods.description: Generates the C source file implementing event encode/decode functions.

methods.name: generateNativeEventAdapterHeader
methods.description: Creates the header file for event adapters, including listener typedefs and registration functions.

methods.name: generateNativeEventAdapterSource
methods.description: Creates the source file implementing event adapter functions, including decode handlers and listener notifications.

methods.name: getEventCodeCaseStatement
methods.description: Builds switch-case statements for event code handling.

methods.name: appendCodes
methods.description: Formats a list of code definitions into #define statements with comments.
